note: Enrichment data sources for the SWIVEL log-enhancer. Flip `enabled` to turn a source on or off. offline_bulk sources are downloaded once by `fetch` and matched locally — captures never leave the machine. Disabling an offline source stops `fetch` from refreshing it; any copy already under data/ keeps being used until you delete it. online_lookup sources send one request per item when you run their command: kept OFF by default, and only ever for fixed infrastructure (Wi-Fi AP BSSIDs) — never client/BLE/randomized MACs, never your GPS (spec R1/R2).

sources.what: IEEE OUI / MA-M / MA-S vendor registries (oui_vendor)
Bluetooth SIG company IDs / service UUIDs / appearance / class (advertised_company, device_class)
ringmast4r OUI-Master-Database device_type (oui_device_type: coarse Router/Phone/Camera/IoT/... per OUI; withheld on randomized MACs like oui_vendor)

WiGLE AP geolocation. Run `wigle <db>` to look up Wi-Fi AP BSSIDs only (never client/BLE/randomized, never GPS). Needs your own WiGLE 'Encoded for use' token in the WIGLE_API_TOKEN environment variable; the tool never stores or prints it.

beaconDB AP geolocation (free, NO key) — a keyless alternative to WiGLE. Run `beacondb <db>`: Wi-Fi AP BSSIDs only (never client/BLE/randomized, never GPS); IP-fallback responses are dropped so your own location is never stored as an AP fix. Note: fccid.io / FCC OET (FCC ID -> device internals/photos) is a MANUAL browser lookup only (it 403s to scripts), so there is no automated path/column for it.
